title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court to the Letter of the Ministry of Labor concerning Several Issues in the Trial of Labor Dispute Cases by the People's Courts

articles.content_en: 2. Where a party to a labor dispute refuses to accept the arbitration decision and initiates a prosecution in the People's Court, the People's Court shall still take the two parties to the dispute as the litigation parties and shall not list the labor dispute arbitration commission as a defendant or a third party. No judgment, ruling, or mediation document shall contain any content revoking or upholding the arbitration decision.

3. Where a party to a labor dispute applies for enforcement of a judgment, ruling, mediation agreement of the People's Court, or an arbitration decision of an arbitration authority in accordance with the provisions, the People's Court shall handle the matter in accordance with the enforcement procedures stipulated in the Civil Procedure Law (for Trial Implementation). During enforcement, if an enterprise refuses to assign work to an employee and neither pays wages nor provides welfare benefits, the People's Court may, in accordance with the provisions of Article 179 of the Civil Procedure Law (for Trial Implementation), notify a bank or credit cooperative to deduct and transfer the payable wages and the welfare benefits that shall be enjoyed, and, if necessary, may order the enterprise to compensate the employee for the actual losses.
August 10, 1989
